summary: Steep arterial kerb with no parked cars, bus zone and tight verge.
reasons: Arterial, no cars parked or lane

drivers.seclusion: Nearest dwellings are 20-22 m away behind a garden, but the kerb is in full view of the road.
drivers.access_and_room: Kerb abuts a planted bank; no clear pull-off, so a van would stand in the lane edge.
drivers.traffic: Busy arterial with a junction and bus zone at the west end.
drivers.convention: No parked cars along this kerb; a bus zone sign and peak-time no stopping sign apply.

flags: Steep: about 5% mean, DEM max 20% at one sample
Bus zone and no stopping 4-6:30pm signs
sun_shade: Bank trees shade the kerb from the south in the afternoon; open to morning sun from the east.

best_section.where: south kerb of Sir Fred Schonell Drive at the western end by the garden bank
